description:
You are a Radiologic Technologist at a hospital neuroradiology department. A radiologist has asked you to prepare a brain MRI study for inclusion in the patient's electronic record by selecting and exporting a standard set of 'key images' per the department's imaging protocol.

The protocol requires:
1. Load the brain MRI series from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/brain_mri/ into Weasis.
2. Apply a brain window preset (Window Width: 80, Window Level: 40) — the standard soft-tissue brain window used in neuroradiology.
3. Select and export exactly THREE key images representing the following standard anatomical levels:
   a. Vertex / high convexity level — showing the superior cortex and white matter
   b. Basal ganglia / thalamus level — showing the caudate nuclei, putamen, and internal capsule
   c. Posterior fossa / cerebellum level — showing the cerebellar hemispheres and fourth ventricle
4. Export each key image as a separate PNG file to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/key_images/:
   - key_image_01.png (vertex level)
   - key_image_02.png (basal ganglia level)
   - key_image_03.png (posterior fossa level)
5. Write a key image summary to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/key_image_summary.txt documenting:
   - The anatomical level for each exported image
   - The slice number or position used
   - The window setting applied (width/level)

Note: The key images must be exported at adequate resolution (at least 20KB each) to be usable for clinical review. Very small thumbnails will not be accepted.
